visualReview.method: Compared source render and colored overlays for both classroom labels, room boundaries, all four retained floor silhouettes, and third/fourth-floor atria.

unplaced.reason: Northern auditorium has no printed room number. Its identity is not inferred from size, use or elimination.

limitations: Relative units only: the existing campus exterior footprint differs from the actual floor diagrams, so uniform georegistration is not claimed.
Floor registration and height are approximate.
Only the two exact classroom labels have room polygons. Other interior rooms are not represented.
Small vestibules, door recesses, columns, exit landings and curved atria are simplified.
The PDF lower floor on page 1 was not part of the previous four-floor inventory and is not imported in this supplement.
